These are the 2nd bail applications U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioners for grant of bail in connection with Nalco Township PS Case No.155 of 2023 corresponding to CT(S) Case No.222 of 2024 (GR Case No.718 of 2023) pending in the file of learned Ad-hoc Additional District and Sessions Judge (FTSC), Angul, for commission of offences punishable U/Ss.365/ 366/ 370(4)/
376(D)/ 109/ 506/ 34 of IPC r/w Sections 25/27 of Arms Act, on the main allegation of committing Gang Rape upon the victim by kidnapping her.
